faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Anganwadi Worker posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the total number of vacancies released by WCD Odisha?
faq.answer: The WCD Odisha has released a total of 12 vacancies across various posts including Anganwadi Worker, Helper, and Anganwadi Helper. Specific details for each post are provided in the vacancy table.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official WCD Odisha website. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and submitting it before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for the Anganwadi Worker and related posts released by WCD Odisha is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed period as per the department's policy.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification date was 31st March 2026, and the last date to apply is 17th September 2026. Candidates should mark these dates to avoid missing the application deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for WCD Odisha recruitment is http://engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in/landing. You can visit this site for more information and to complete your application.
